An FBI whistleblower tells Tucker Carlson he was punished for supporting Donald Trump in this episode. The agent's charge is that the bureau has become politicized against conservatives in its own ranks. Carlson presents the claim as a chilling sign of a system that bites back.

The whistleblower describes the investigations, suspensions, and pressure he says followed his views becoming known. He argues his case is one of many meant to scare others silent. Carlson asks what protection whistleblower laws really gave him. Concerned and skeptical viewers get an insider's account of a bureau at war with itself.
